chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Budapest, 2019, the Champions League final. Lyon lead Barcelona four-nil, one minute left. Martens slips it through. Asisat Oshoala gets there first, one touch round the keeper... and in!

chapters.label: First to react
chapters.text: Watch again. The pass is played, and Asisat reacts first. Her defender is a step behind.

chapters.label: One touch
chapters.text: One touch past Bouhaddi. She slides it home, and it trickles in! The first African to score in a Women's Champions League final.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Stay alert in the box. React first, one quick touch, and finish. The quickest striker to react often scores!
